title: MedCARAG: Context-Aware Medical RAG Benchmark and Full-Text Index
description: Code, benchmark (MeSH-derived queries and qrels), readiness metrics, per-query results and generated answers for MedCARAG (Medical Context-Aware RAG): section-typed indexes over 4,044,247 PubMed Central Open Access full-text articles and 20.5M PubMed abstracts, used to test context-aware retrieval against direct retrieval-augmented generation in medicine. No article text is redistributed.
